messages:
Ivy: Proposal  9-day sprint. Launch a guided cost calculator + FAQ micro-update + 2 slab-name variants. Objective: increase qualified demo requests.

Max: Sounds good. Quick ask: can the calculator recommend a quantization profile and suggested plan? Capture email opt-in.

Rhea: Yes. UX idea  inline CTA after results: 'Request a tailored cost review'. That can map to SDR if lead looks hot.

SalesOps-bot: staging event: calc_started 12, calc_submitted 7 in last 8h.

Ivy: Draft routing rules (review): monthly_est >= 1200 OR team_size >= 4 -> assign_sdr; opt_in true -> notify_growth; else -> add_to_nurture.

Max: Great. For slab names, Option A: Launch / Scale / Reserved. Option B: Lite / Pro / Enterprise. A/B test hero + table labels 50/50.

Rhea: Webinar blurb: 'Which Redwood plan matches your inference needs'  25m demo + 10m Q&A. We'll show benchmark slide but phrase as 'up to 3x depending on workload' and include methodology notes. Loop legal.

legal: Please include slides with test configs and raw numbers if using comparative claims. Keep copy 'up to' and conservative.

Ivy: Timeline: Tue finalize names & CTA, Wed deploy calculator to staging, Thu HubSpot mapping test, Fri micro-webinar. Track events: calc_start, calc_submit, faq_cta_click, sdr_assigned. Tag experiment=pricing-guided-2026.

Max: I'll make two hero copy variants and share assets. Rhea, can you scope the mini FAQ bullets?

Rhea: On it  3 bullets: unit economics, SLA/latency choices, when to pick Dedicated. Short & scannable.

Ivy: Perfect. I'll create the doc and calendar invite. Thanks all  we'll review first-day metrics. :rocket:
